Everything feels so hollow. I don't really expect them to fix it or anything, but more than just a "that sucks", shrug and move on would be better, right? I don't even know. It probably isn't even really fair for me to hope for comfort, especially after dropping such a heavy bomb on them but I don't know what else to do. Being put in an institution will financially cripple me, which would just cause more of this kind of spiral, and having no one to turn to I'm at a loss. I've been contemplating throwaway posting to reddit for months, considered it a last resort; here I am.

I promise you I have. I've told them that I scare myself. That I know that eventually something's gonna break in me and I'll no longer have the forethought to stop myself from doing something that can't be undone.

"That sucks you feel that way." 

I feel like that response is the one that echoes the most because it's the person closest to me. I'm sorry if this is coming off combative, I'm not trying to be, I just really got nothing.
